“There is so much I wish to say, but so little time. In all honesty, I don’t know who to thank for bringing me here to this place. To all these amazing adventures I’ve had. To all these people I’m proud to call my friends. So much has happened in just these few short months, however I know the worst is yet to come. My friends and I, are about to take on a difficult task. One that even got the better of some of you. I don’t say that out of disrespect, just trying to put into perspective what it is we are about to do. So I’d like to pray to a few specific gods who have helped us on this journey so far.
To Melora, I pray for your wisdom and your kindness. You have shown me much joy, and shown me how to forgive people. I thank you, and I ask you be with us in this fight.
To the Raven Queen, I pray for your continued Protection. You have given us a great gift. Lilia. Without her this battle would probably be much more difficult. I pray for your continued protection of her, and of us. We will need it.

And to all other gods who have watched over us, and I just didn’t notice. Thank you. Thank you all. I pray to each and everyone of you. Please, guide us.”
